title: 第130章 好恨啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 听完唐逸的话，龙斩和暗京楼一众高手，全都气炸了。他们刚才不相信唐逸能一刀破万军，可现在唐逸一刀之下，他们暗京楼上百精锐死伤殆尽。早知如此，就不该轻敌的，可惜晚了，暗京楼多年的自傲，将他们推入了深渊。“呵呵，哈哈……”龙斩吐掉嘴里的血沫，看向唐逸和炎文帝：“我承认，这次是我们轻敌了，但那又如何？你们……必死在我暗京楼手上。”炎文帝嘴角笑容渐渐收敛，都这时候了，还狂呢？你们还真当朕是摆设啊！“轻敌？不？这一次，你们彻底败了。”炎文帝背着双手向前走了两步，居高临下盯着龙斩：“朕还没出手，你们已经躺下了，你是怎么有底气，在朕面前狂妄的？”龙斩脸色一僵，猛地抬头死死盯着炎文帝：“这不是你安排的？！”他的声音有些歇斯底里，他不是不能接受失败，而且败在炎文帝这样的老狐狸手中，他虽然愤怒却没有什么怨言。可现在，炎文帝却告诉他，他还没出手？那刚才和他决战的唐逸算怎么回事？炎文帝指了指自己的脸，道：“你看朕的脸，现在还充满震惊和难以置信，要是朕安排的，朕会这么失态吗？朕不要面子？”众人齐齐看向炎文帝，也都瞪大了双眼。合着你刚才一副尽在掌控中的样子，全是装出来的是吧？“撤，立即撤，逃……”龙斩没有再说半句废话，转身瞬间向外掠去。甚至连心腹孙霸和那仅存的暗京楼高手，都被他全部抛下了。哪怕再不甘，他也不得不承认失败了，再不逃等待他的只有死亡，只有全军覆没。刚才出手的只是唐逸，一个唐逸就让他们近乎死伤殆尽，而炎文帝的势力几乎没有受到半点损失，早就严阵以待。现在和炎文帝再打一场？那是找死！“逃？现在知道逃了？晚了！”炎文帝一挥手，道：“去吧，活口一个不留！活捉之人，全部凌迟处死！从此大炎京都就是他暗京楼的禁地。”“是。”宁川，苏狂立即带着锦衣卫追了出去。萧棣眼神顿时炙热起来，现在终于轮到他大展拳脚了，要知道锦衣卫早就将暗京楼的安全屋全部掌控了。现在暗京楼的人敢逃回安全屋，等待他们的就是一颗炸弹！而唐逸看着萧棣宁川等人踩着水面飞走了，抱着剑顿时就尴尬了，我擦的，我这还去不去了？去吧，跟不上，还极有可能被人趁机灭了。不去吧，锦衣卫的人都走了啊！“你就留下吧，你这样子出去也是丢人，简直就是锦衣卫之耻。”炎文帝睨着他，脸上那是一个嫌弃。唐逸同样睨着他，脸上那是一个不爽，锦衣卫之耻？请你组织语言重新说一遍。老子可是刚刚一刀为你解决了大炎数十年毒瘤的男人。“现在，朕宣布唐逸为此次沈园诗会的第一名，谁支持谁反对？！”炎文帝背着手，目光扫过全场。刚才很多人都有意见，可见识到唐逸一刀灭暗京楼全场，现在全都在胆战心惊，鬼知道他在现场还有没有埋炸雷？谁敢反对？使团那边，秦钰也沉默下来，宇文封虽然不甘，恨不得当场格杀唐逸，可现在也不敢放肆，只能忍了下来。“陛下圣明，臣等并无异议。”群臣拱手起身说道。连各家夫人，嫡女，包括颜霜玉和姜云娜在内，也都齐齐敛衽行礼，没有人敢有半点质疑。哪怕颜霜玉和姜云娜眼中的恨意，几乎都要溢出来了，也只能忍气吞声，眼睁睁看着唐逸身带光环。“既然无异议，那就好办了。”炎文帝一甩衣袖，沉声道：“唐逸上前听封。”听封？封赏？群臣眉心直跳，陛下你还真是不带半点忍耐的，竟然直接趁现在铁板钉钉，不给我们半点拒绝的机会。无耻啊！唐逸眼睛一亮，封赏，这个可以有。现在我就一个锦衣卫百户，身份不够随意被人拿捏，这种感觉让人很不爽。他当即上前，跪地拱手道：“臣唐逸听封。”炎文帝盯着唐逸，道：“吏部侍郎……不，现在是京兆府少尹唐敬之子唐逸，学识渊博，德才兼备，武力……嗯，武力一般，破格擢升，调任京兆府府尹！上任期待定！”“另，唐逸大破暗京楼，为大炎除掉吸附大炎数十年的毒瘤，忠勇有加，又创出轰天雷献于朝廷，功莫大焉。”“因此，封忠勇侯，赏黄金千两，锦缎百匹！”哗！炎文帝话音刚落，整个鹿鸣湖瞬间就沸腾了。“沈园诗会第一名，调任京兆府府尹，封侯……天啊，唐逸这是一飞冲天了啊！”“哈哈，唐家最看不上的少年，一跃成了京都新贵，这脸打得啪啪响啊！”“京兆府尹，忠勇侯，无论是在爵位还是职位上都比唐敬还高，真想知道此时唐敬是什么想法啊！”“……”议论宛若海浪一般席卷开。听着这些议论声，唐敬脸色阴晴不定，难堪至极。他什么想法？他想死！自诩英明一世，却没想到今日丢人丢得如此彻底。最看重的儿子是个假货，最看不上的儿子现在不仅成了侯爵，还成了他的顶头上司。皇帝这巴掌打得，打得响亮。群臣也都怒不可遏，觉得炎文帝给唐逸的恩赐太大了。可是却没人敢站出来反驳，连那些御史言官，此时也都不敢出半点气。皇帝擢升唐逸为京兆府尹，那是从三品的官职，主政京都，可以说是权力通天，他们肯定是不愿意的，可炎文帝说了上任期不定。这就给了他们一个缓冲的期限，他们想反驳都不好反驳。封唐逸侯爵，他们更不愿意，这家伙还是个锦衣卫百户就这么难对付了，再让他封侯，那他还不得翻天？然而，他们还是没办法反驳。因为唐逸一刀灭掉暗京楼是他们亲眼所见，轰天雷的威力也是他们亲眼所见，唐逸的功劳更是他们亲眼所见，这怎么反驳？一个侯爵，他唐逸受得起。这让刘温等一众大臣欲哭无泪，他们知道沈园诗会，是皇帝给唐逸铺路。可现在这哪里是铺路，直接借助暗京楼，将唐逸捧上了云端！好恨啊！
content_en: After hearing what Tang Yi said, Long Zhan and all the masters from Anjing Tower were furious.Just now they didn't believe that Tang Yi could defeat ten thousand troops with one sword, but now under Tang Yi's sword, hundreds of elites in their secret capital were killed and injured.If they had known this earlier, they should not have underestimated the enemy. Unfortunately, it was too late. An Jinglou's years of pride pushed them into the abyss."Haha, haha..." Long Zhan spat out the blood foam in his mouth and looked at Tang Yi and Emperor Yanwen: "I admit that this time we underestimated the enemy, but so what? You... will die at the hands of An Jinglou." The smile on Emperor Yanwen's lips gradually faded. It's already this time, are you still crazy?You really treat me as a decoration!"Underestimating the enemy? No? This time, you are completely defeated." Emperor Yanwen took two steps forward with his hands behind his back and stared at Long Zhan from a high position: "You are already lying down before I take action. How do you have the confidence to be arrogant in front of me?" Long Zhan's faceHis face stiffened, and he suddenly raised his head and stared at Emperor Yanwen: "Didn't you arrange this?!" His voice was a little hysterical. It was not that he couldn't accept failure, and he was defeated at the hands of an old fox like Emperor Yanwen. Although he was angry, he had no complaints.But now, Emperor Yanwen told him that he hadn't taken action yet?So what happened to Tang Yi who had a decisive battle with him just now?Emperor Yanwen pointed at his face and said: "Look at my face, it is still full of shock and disbelief. If it was arranged by me, would I be so rude? I don't want to lose face?" Everyone looked at Emperor Yanwen with their eyes widened.The way you looked like you were in control just now was all just an act, right?"Retreat, retreat immediately, run away..." Long Zhan didn't say any more nonsense, turned around and swept away in an instant.Even his confidant Sun Ba and the only remaining master of Anjing Tower were abandoned by him.No matter how unwilling he was, he had to admit defeat. If he didn't escape, the only thing waiting for him would be death and the annihilation of his entire army.It was only Tang Yi who took action just now. One Tang Yi almost killed and injured all of them. However, Emperor Yanwen's forces hardly suffered any losses and were already well prepared.Now have another fight with Emperor Yanwen?That's courting death!"Escape? Do you know you have escaped now? It's too late!" Emperor Yan Wen waved his hand and said, "Go, leave no one alive! Anyone caught alive will be executed in Lingchi! From now on, Great Yan Jingdu will be the forbidden area of ​​​​his Anjing Tower." "Yes." Ningchuan, Su Kuang and the Jin Yiwei immediately chased out.Xiao Di's eyes suddenly became hot. Now it was finally his turn to show off his skills. You must know that Jin Yiwei had already controlled all the safe houses in Anjing Tower.Now that the people in Anjing Tower dare to escape back to the safe house, what awaits them is a bomb!And Tang Yi saw Xiao Di Ningchuan and others flying away on the water, holding the sword and suddenly felt embarrassed, I wiped it, can I go now?Go ahead, if you can't keep up, it's very likely that someone will take the opportunity to kill you.Don't go, everyone from Jinyiwei has left!"Just stay. It's a shame for you to go out like this. It's simply a shame for the Imperial Guard." Emperor Yan Wen looked at him with a look of disgust on his face.Tang Yi also looked at him, with a look of displeasure on his face. What a shame for Jin Yiwei?Please organize your language and say it again.I am the man who has just treated you with a single blow of a knife that has caused decades of cancer in Great Yan."Now, I announce that Tang Yi is the first place winner of this Shen Yuan Poetry Contest. Who supports and who opposes?!" Emperor Yan Wen clasped his hands behind his back and glanced across the audience.Many people had opinions just now. It can be seen that after seeing Tang Yi destroying the entire Anjing Tower with one strike, everyone is trembling in fear. Who knows if he has planted any explosives at the scene?Who dares to object?Over at the mission, Qin Yu also fell silent. Although Yu Wenfeng was unwilling to give up and wanted to kill Tang Yi on the spot, he did not dare to act recklessly now and could only endure it."Your Majesty is wise, I have no objection." The ministers raised their hands and said.Even the wives and legitimate daughters of each family, including Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna, all bowed and bowed, and no one dared to question him at all.Even though the hatred in Yan Shuangyu and Jiang Yunna's eyes almost overflowed, they could only swallow their anger and watch Tang Yi wearing a halo."Since there is no objection, it will be easy to handle." Emperor Yanwen flicked his sleeves and said solemnly: "Tang Yi stepped forward to listen to the seal." Listen to the seal?Reward?The eyebrows of the ministers were pounding. Your Majesty, you really don't have any patience. You actually took advantage of the ironclad situation and didn't give us any chance to refuse.Shameless!Tang Yi's eyes lit up and he said, "You can get a reward."Now I am just a member of the Jinyiwei family, and my identity is not enough to be manipulated at will. This feeling is very unpleasant.He immediately stepped forward, knelt down and cupped his hands and said: "Your Majesty Tang Yi accepts the title." Emperor Yanwen stared at Tang Yi and said: "Secretary of the Ministry of Civil Affairs... No, now he is Tang Yi, the son of Tang Jing, the young Yin of Jingzhao Mansion. He is knowledgeable, has both ability and political integrity, and his military force... well, his military force is average. He was promoted to the capital under special circumstances.The appointment of the governor of Zhaofu is to be determined!""In addition, Tang Yi destroyed the Anjing Tower and eliminated the cancer that had been adsorbing the disease for decades. He also created the Thunderous Thunder and presented it to the court.He has done a great job." "Therefore, I will be awarded the title of Marquis of Zhongyong, a thousand taels of gold, and a hundred pieces of brocade!"As soon as Emperor Yanwen finished speaking, the entire Luming Lake boiled instantly."The first place in the Shen Yuan Poetry Society, transferred to Jingzhao Prefecture, and made a marquis... Oh my god, Tang Yi has soared to the sky!" "Haha, the most despised young man in the Tang family has suddenly become a new rich man in Kyoto. It's such a slap in the face!" "Jingzhao Prefecture, Zhongyong Marquis, is higher than Tang Jing in terms of title and position. I really want to know what Tang Jing is thinking at this time!" "..." The discussion spread like a wave of waves.Listening to these discussions, Tang Jing's face was filled with uncertainty and embarrassment.What does he think?He wants to die!He claims to be a wise man, but he didn't expect that he would be so thoroughly embarrassed today.The son he valued the most was a fake, and the son he despised the most was now not only a marquis, but also his immediate boss.The emperor's slap was very loud.The ministers were also furious, feeling that Emperor Yanwen's gift to Tang Yi was too great.But no one dared to stand up and refute, not even the imperial censors dared to vent their anger at this time.The emperor promoted Tang Yi to the position of Jingzhao Prefecture, which was a third-grade official position. He was in charge of Kyoto and could be said to be powerful. They were definitely unwilling to do so, but Emperor Yanwen said that his term would be uncertain.This gives them a buffer period, and it is difficult for them to refute even if they want to.They were even more unwilling to be granted the title of Marquis of Tang Yi. This guy was still so difficult to deal with even though he was a member of the Imperial Guard. If he was granted the title of Marquis, would he be able to turn the world upside down?However, they still couldn't refute.Because they saw Tang Yi destroy Anjing Tower with their own eyes.
title_en: Chapter 130 I hate it so much!
